title: Free-Transform warp + affine: warped shape with scaleX/scaleY/rotation double-transforms in published SWF
description: FIXED. Root cause: task 1228 bakes the Distort/Envelope warp into ABSOLUTE-stage DefineShape4 geometry (then subtracts the placement offset), so the baked edges already encode the full scale/rotation effect (warp corners are captured from the already scaled/rotated AABB, in stage space). But the frame loop (compiler/frames.ts) still built objTransform={scaleX,scaleY,rotation} for every shape, so a shape with BOTH a warp AND non-identity scale/rotation was transformed TWICE in the SWF (baked warp + PlaceObject2 affine) while the editor renderer (engine/renderer.ts) draws ONLY the warp (the if(obj.warp) branch supersedes the affine else-if). Fix: gate the objTransform construction on 'displayObj.type===shape && !displayObj.warp' in BOTH emit branches (first-placement + move) so a warped shape gets objTransform=undefined (identity scale/rotate, translate-only); PlaceObject2 tx/ty still positions it. DrawingObject already used undefined so it was never affected. Regression test: packages/swf/src/__tests__/warp-affine-double-transform.test.ts (6 tests) decodes the PlaceObject2 MATRIX + DefineShape4 ShapeBounds from our own compiled SWF: warp+scaleX=2 and warp+rotation=30 => hasScale=hasRotate=false with un-doubled bounds (5000x4000 twips, not 10000x8000); pure-warp unchanged; pure-affine (scaleX=2 / rotation=30, no warp) STILL sets hasScale/hasRotate with pristine 2000x2000 bounds (no regression). Verified the 2 double-transform cases FAIL without the fix and pass with it. RESULTS: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build = GREEN (typecheck). pnpm --filter @flash/swf test --run = 114 files / 1394 tests PASS (incl. 6 new). pnpm --filter @flash/core test --run = 331 files / 5295 tests PASS; only 3 pre-existing FAILs (carchive-validate / contents-structure / empty-bytematch) all ENOENT on missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (task 1207), unrelated. Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md + CLAUDE.md updated.
